Process

How It Works

Getting started is simple. Complete these four steps and you're on your way to winning exclusive Apple rewards.

01✍️

Register & Opt In

Sign up with WINPROFX and opt into the Trade to Win program from your first deposit.

02🎯

Choose Your Tier

Select the reward tier you're aiming for — from a Power Bank all the way to the latest iPhone.

03📊

Trade Within 30 Days

Hit your target trading volume within 30 days. Eligible trades must be held for at least 3 minutes.

Once you reach your volume goal, your reward is confirmed and dispatched to you.
